scope: 19 active catalog items: 16 sector models and 3 strip models
notes: Transcribed factual performance cells from current official Hunter web tables, read via web tool on 2026-10-10. No remote pages downloaded through CLI.
Tables are alternatives, not directly convertible identical datasets; keep source families internally coherent.
Metric Standard/Corner first pressure is 2.0 bar online but 2.1 bar in the official RevJ metric Design Guide. Do not silently extend operating bounds.
Metric MP815 online precipitation header says in/hr; metric Design Guide identifies these numeric values as mm/hr.
US MP-SS-530 at 55 psi has conflicting GPH=38.4 and GPM=0.47. GPM retained as the coherent flow source; GPH preserved here as evidence.
Strip precipitation columns describe layout-dependent rates, not generic sector square/triangle rates.
